title: TikTok Seller Central Explained: Sign Up, Log In, and Run Your Shop From Seller Center
summary: TikTok Seller Central and Seller Center, decoded. Learn the US sign-up steps, how to log in and fix access issues, what the dashboard controls, and how the Affiliate Center drives sales.
body_markdown:
## Frequently Asked Questions


### Is TikTok Seller Center legit?


TikTok Seller Center is the official, legitimate platform for running a TikTok Shop in the US. Register only through seller-us.tiktok.com or TikTok's official app listings, and never enter credentials into third-party APK files or unofficial software claiming to be TikTok tools.


### How do I start selling on TikTok?


Start selling on TikTok by registering at seller-us.tiktok.com, the official US Seller Center. Choose the seller type that matches your legal setup, submit identity or business documents, payment and tax details, then complete shop setup after approval before listing products.


### Do I need 1,000 followers to sell on TikTok?


No, TikTok does not require a minimum follower count to open a seller shop. Seller registration and creator affiliate eligibility are different processes with different requirements, so follow the criteria displayed in the US Seller Center during sign-up rather than an old checklist.


### What is the difference between TikTok Seller Central and Seller Center?


TikTok Seller Center is the official name for TikTok's shop-management platform in the US. TikTok seller central is simply a common search term for that same workspace, not a separate product, so use the official seller portal to register and avoid signing up in the wrong place.


### How long does TikTok Seller Center approval take?


There is no reliable universal approval timeline for TikTok Seller Center. Review duration depends on the information submitted, document quality, and any additional checks TikTok requests. Keep documents legible and consistent with your application, and monitor Seller Center notices while your status is pending.


### What documents do I need to sign up for TikTok Seller Center?


TikTok Seller Center requires government-issued ID for individual sellers, business registration details for companies, a valid US address, payment and tax information, and clear, unaltered document images. The portal determines which documents apply to your account type, and additional verification can be requested.


### How much does it cost to be a TikTok Shop seller?


Registering for TikTok Seller Center itself is free, and the portal displays any applicable fees during onboarding.
